mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market and potential recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive months of positive MoM growth, signals strengthening supply-side momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 3 consecutive months of positive MoM INDPRO growth
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is above 6%, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, defined as a 200,000 decline in PAYEMS over the past month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and potential recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 200,000 PAYEMS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the CPI is rising by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals an overly accommodative monetary policy that will lead to higher inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth accelerating by more than 3% quarter-over-quarter, combined with a falling unemployment rate, signals a surging economy that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3% and UNRATE declining
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when the trigger condition is met.
